apps.name: SpacePartner
apps.tagline: Run a coworking business on one system.
apps.description: An India-native operating system for coworking operators. Sales, onboarding, credits and billing, daily use, community, support, renewals and exits, on one private system your members see under your brand.

highlights.title: One app, every role
highlights.text: Members, company admins and seven staff consoles, from reception to billing.

highlights.title: Private by design
highlights.text: Each operator gets its own instance. No shared database.

highlights.title: Grows with you
highlights.text: Run one centre or fifty from the same system.

apps.name: ERPBlueprint
apps.description: Answer plain-English questions about how your business runs. Get a Business Requirements Document that says, chapter by chapter, how your ERPNext should be set up.

highlights.title: Plain English in
highlights.text: Answer questions about how your business runs. No ERP jargon.

highlights.title: A real BRD out
highlights.text: Chapter by chapter: what is standard, what needs settings, what needs building.

highlights.title: AI with a fence
highlights.text: A rule engine decides. AI only helps with the wording.

groups.title: Under the hood
items: Rule engine with an AI fence

apps.name: TraitAtlas
apps.description: Eight short tests on personality, career interests, values, work style and wellbeing. Every report is in plain language, with a character from everyday Indian life.

highlights.title: Research, not horoscopes
highlights.text: Built on published instruments, with scoring you can explain.

highlights.title: Characters you know
highlights.text: Results come as characters from everyday Indian life.

highlights.title: Made to share
highlights.text: A 9:16 card for WhatsApp, and compare-with-a-friend.

apps.name: PressPilot
apps.description: A production-grade mobile client for Frappe Press and Frappe Cloud. Your sites, benches, deploys and notifications, from your phone.

highlights.title: Deploys on the go
highlights.text: Sites, benches and deploys, from your pocket.

highlights.title: Know first
highlights.text: Notifications from your Frappe Cloud account.

highlights.title: Password used once
highlights.text: Swapped for a token in secure storage, then forgotten.

apps.name: Gold Lending
apps.tagline: Gold loans, by the RBI book.
apps.description: A gold-loan layer on ERPNext and Frappe Lending. It turns the RBI 2025 directions on gold collateral, digital lending and KYC into settings, so a new NBFC goes live with configuration, not code.

highlights.title: Compliance as settings
highlights.text: RBI gold, digital lending and KYC directions, built in.

highlights.title: Gold, tracked end to end
highlights.text: Appraisal, assay, vault custody, release and auctions.

highlights.title: Configure, don't code
highlights.text: A new NBFC goes live by changing settings.

items: KFS and APR with charge freeze

about.subtitle: The Tiny Apps Company
about.headline: We pick one narrow problem and go all the way down.
paragraphs: A coworking operator's whole member lifecycle. An NBFC's gold-loan rulebook. An ERPNext rollout, planned before a single setting is touched.
Each product is small enough to fit one icon, and deep enough that the people using it every day stop needing a second tool.

team.subtitle: Small on purpose
team.headline: A tiny team, with a lot of help from machines.

members.name: The AI team
members.bio: Agents that draft specs, run tests and keep the docs current. A human approves before anything ships.

rules.title: One niche, all the way down
rules.text: We would rather solve one industry's whole workflow than ten industries' first screen.

rules.title: India first
rules.text: GST, RBI directions, the DPDP Act, Hinglish and WhatsApp are part of the design, not add-ons.

rules.title: Open-source foundations
rules.text: Frappe and ERPNext underneath, so your data and your system stay yours.

rules.title: Docs ship with the code
rules.text: Our products come with playbooks for admins, users and testers.

contact.note: Have a niche problem nobody has built for yet? Tell us about it.
